clauses.title: Data protection by design and by default

expects.description: Each requirement's implementation plan records the privacy-by-design choices.
A record of processing activities is on file for the project. A record older than a year is shown as expired.
The same record, recognised by its file name, so the clause is still met if it was uploaded without the usual evidence type.
Static-analysis results, a dependency audit or a security summary from the delivery pipeline.
An audit log snapshot shows that access to data can be traced.

clauses.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority

expects.description: A personal-data breach notification is on file as an incident report. The 72-hour notification window applies.

clauses.title: Communication of a personal data breach to the data subject

expects.description: The notice to affected individuals is on file as an incident report. One upload can serve both this clause and the notification to the authority, depending on its scope.
A data protection impact assessment is on file for the project. An assessment older than a year is shown as expired.
